summary: Enerflex Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, attaching an amended and restated credit agreement dated June 24, 2026. The filing is a routine report of a credit facility amendment with no terms disclosed such as price, stake, or premium. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural details related to a special situation. The event is an ordinary financing update, not a special situation acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. Watch for no risk-arb angle; this is a standard current report of a credit agreement modification.
